property_summary: For any assertionId and any gas budget in an admissible window, a call by the optimistic asserter to assertionDisputedCallback must be a near-no-op that completes within that budget; the mutant's spurious PriceRequestAdded emission makes the call exceed the budget, so the low-level call reverts for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert an emission of PriceRequestAdded inside assertionDisputedCallback so calls produce an observable event.
